quests.name: Astral Light: The Sun's Shards
quests.offer:
The light hums. It wants a chain's shards, all of them, from one hand.
Feed it the Sun's Shards, the 4 yellow ones? All near you go too.

steps.journal: Bring the Astral Light all 4 yellow shards, and those who will fight beside you.
steps.says: The light flares. The plane falls away beneath you.
steps.reminder: The light wants all 4 yellow shards, from one hand.

events.text: The light is held: others stand on its isle. Come back when they are done.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/plane-of-sky.json, ## Plane of Sky Talon & Bulwark and the chains' All About Shards (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Turning in the yellow shards flags the player to buy them again from Wibble (the note from Crimz). Sends up to 16 (a pet counting one) within 40 of the Light; one raid at a time on the isle (the lock 'sky isle' is ours).

quests.name: Wibble's Sun's Shards
quests.offer:
You have fed the light. I found more of the Sun's Shards, every one.
Five thousand tunar for the 4 yellow shards?
quests.declined: As you like. They will keep.

steps.journal: Pay Wibble Gninogin 5,000 tunar for the 4 yellow shards.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/plane-of-sky.json, ## Plane of Sky Talon & Bulwark and the chains' All About Shards (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). 5,000 tunar for the whole set (the guide's 'more shards ... for 5k'), to anyone who has turned that chain's shards in; repeatable.

quests.name: The Maiden's Shard
quests.offer:
They come for me again. The bishops, Millian and Lancel.
Save me once more, and what I carry is yours.

steps.journal: Kill Arch Bishop Millian in his tower.
Kill Arch Bishop Lancel in his tower.

steps.says: I am safe again. Take this.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/plane-of-sky.json, ## Plane of Sky Talon & Bulwark and the chains' All About Shards (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). Night 3: the guide's shard is hers, for speaking with her. The chain's own step gives it the first time (its done event, added by tools/guidegaps/sky-twins.json); this is the way to it again, the two bishops the guide says to kill.

quests.name: The Multicoloured Lights
quests.offer:
The essence turns slowly. Five lights would wake it, one from each construct.
Will you feed it the multicoloured lights? All near you go too.

steps.journal: Bring the astral essence the five construct shards, and those who will fight beside you.
steps.says: The lights go in, and the essence opens. Thirty minutes.
steps.reminder: It wants a shard from each of the five constructs, from one hand.

events.text: The essence is held: others stand on its isle. Come back when they are done.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/plane-of-sky.json, ## Plane of Sky Talon & Bulwark and the chains' All About Shards (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The five construct shards at the astral essence (CS's notes), at the main isle's or the Isle of Wonder's: up to 16 within 40 of the player go.

quests.name: The Scale of Veeshan
quests.offer:
A scale of the twins? Oh, let me see it. I pay for a look, and the Storyteller wants the tale.
Will you show me?

steps.journal: Show Veeshan's Scale to Wibble Gninogin on the main isle.
steps.says: Beautiful. Beautiful! Now take it to the Storyteller, in Baga Village.
steps.reminder: Bring me a scale of the twins.

steps.journal: Take Veeshan's Scale to The Storyteller in Baga Village.
steps.says: So that is what you found up there. Tell me all of it.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/Portal/plane-of-sky.json, ## Plane of Sky Talon & Bulwark and the chains' All About Shards (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). RIP's note: Wibble first (100 million experience), then The Storyteller, 50 faction. Offered at Wibble's window once a session, as a merchant's quests are.
